title: Estera
claim: Estera — an AI receptionist that answers a business's phone calls and WhatsApp 24/7 (Product Hunt launch, 129 upvotes).
why_good: An AI receptionist that answers a business's phone and WhatsApp 24/7 — a clear ROI for SMBs losing calls after hours.
value: Per-seat/per-minute SaaS to SMBs (clinics, salons, trades); missed calls = lost revenue, so they pay readily.
risk: Crowded AI-voice-receptionist space; reliability, latency and local-language handling decide the winners.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Estera —— 一个 7×24 接听企业电话和 WhatsApp 的 AI 前台(Product Hunt,129 分)。
zh.why_good: 一个 7×24 接听企业电话和 WhatsApp 的 AI 前台——对 下班后漏接电话 的中小企业 ROI 清晰。
